decisions.statement: The record taken out is the one whose named field states the text handed in.
A key with no record is refused.
Text no record states under that field is refused.
Text more than one record states under that field is refused.
That refusal says how many records state it.
A property keeps its key when the last record goes.
The body is answered rather than written.
The passage answered is the lines the record is taken out of rather than the body.
Nothing here reads what the record means.
The only text written here is the empty string.
No page is taken away here.

definition: one record taken out of one page property in a page's body
